source_note: Upstream project (modood/Administrative-divisions-of-China) is no longer maintained; its mainland data is based on the 2023 statistical division codes (as of 2023-06-30). Official county-level changes announced after that date have been applied manually against Ministry of Civil Affairs / provincial civil affairs announcements.
changes: 2024-12-27: added 和康县 (653228) and 和安县 (653229), Hotan Prefecture, Xinjiang
2025-11-07: Chongqing — revoked 江北区 (500105) and 渝北区 (500112), added 两江新区 (500157), code per Chongqing Civil Affairs announcement of 2025-12-05
Rewrote mainland en-GB translations in GB/T 17693 style (joined pinyin + official generic terms)
Replaced HK/MO/TW pinyin transliterations with official/conventional English names (HK district councils, Macao parishes, Taiwan postal romanization)

Removed township-level (9-digit) entries under county-directly-administered cities (Dongguan 36, Zhongshan 23, Danzhou 18, Jiayuguan 5); fixture keeps 3 levels only (province / city / county-level). Those 4 cities now have empty children lists.
